Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
My God, indeed
Nothing repels Your anger except Your clemency

Arabic text: وَلَا يُنْجِيْ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ اِلَّا عَفْوُكَ
Translation: And nothing saves from Your punishment except Your forgiveness

Arabic text: وَلَا يُخَلِّصُ مِنْكَ اِلَّا رَحْمَتُكَ وَ التَّضَرُّعُ اِلَيْكَ
Translation: And nothing delivers from You except Your mercy and humble entreaty to You

Arabic text: فَهَبْ لِيْ يَا اِلٰهِيْ فَرَحًا بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِيْ
Translation: So grant me, O my God, relief through the power by which
You revive the dead lands
And by which You resurrect the souls of Your servants
Do not destroy me, and let me recognize Your answer

Arabic text: يَارَبِّ وَ ارْفَعْنِيْ وَ لَا تَضَعْنِيْ
Translation: O Lord, raise me up and do not put me down
Support me and provide for me
And protect me from calamities
O my Lord
If You raise me, who can put me down?
And if You put me down, who can raise me?
I have learned, O my God, that
There is no injustice in Your judgment
And no haste in Your vengeance
Only those who fear missing an opportunity make haste
And only the weak need to resort to injustice

Arabic text: وَ قَدْ تَعَالَيْتَ عَنْ ذٰلِكَ يَا سَيِّدِيْ عُلُوًّا كَبِيْرًا
Translation: You are far above that, O my Master, exceedingly high
My Lord, do not make me
A target for affliction
Nor an object for Your vengeance
Grant me respite and relief
And forgive my errors
And do not follow me with affliction

Arabic text: فَقَدْ تَرٰى ضَعْفِيْ وَ قِلَّةَ حِيْلَتِيْ
Translation: For You see my weakness and my limited resources

Arabic text: فَصَبِّرْنِيْ فَإِنِّيْ يَا رَبِّ ضَعِيْفٌ مُتَضَرِّعٌ اِلَيْكَ يَا رَبِّ
Translation: So grant me patience, for I am, O Lord, weak and beseeching You, O Lord
I seek refuge in You from You, so protect me

Arabic text: وَ اَنْتَ الْعَظِيْمُ اَعْظَمُ مِنْ كُلِّ عَظِيْمٍ
Translation: You are the Greatest, greater than every great thing
By You, by You, by You I have sought concealment

Arabic text: يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ
Translation: O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and his pure and purified family
